title: Net Transfer Fees Paid and the Refunds and Fees Callback — Personal Sender Account
content:
For a callback on refunds and fees to a Personal Sender Account holder, fees paid are the USD fees collected on the customer's Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup and Mobile Wallet transfers in the 12 months before the callback request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting, less the USD fees refunded on them in the same 12 months.

## Schedule

| Fees paid (USD, fees collected less fees refunded) | Business days added to the counted fees callback window |
|---|---|
| 70.00 or more | 2 |
| at least 30.00 but below 70.00 | 1 |
| below 30.00 | 0 |

When fees paid are 70.00 USD or more, 2 business days are added to the counted fees callback window; when they are at least 30.00 USD but below 70.00 USD, 1 business day is added; when they are below 30.00 USD, nothing is added for fees paid.

## The entries read

Fees collected are the fee charged entries in the ledgers of the customer's transfers; fees refunded are the fee refunded entries in the same ledgers. Both are taken in USD over the same 12 months, across all three delivery methods.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Fees collected | Fees refunded | Fees paid | Business days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 85.00 | 15.00 | 70.00 | 2 |
| 85.00 | 15.01 | 69.99 | 1 |
| 45.00 | 15.00 | 30.00 | 1 |
| 45.00 | 15.01 | 29.99 | 0 |
